purpose: Catalogue inventory for reconciliation; config/channels.js remains the runtime source of truth.
preservationRules: No catalogue entries are removed by the inventory generation process.
No IDs or channel numbers are changed by the inventory generation process.
Missing numbers are recorded, not filled automatically.
A webUrl records the official page supplied for opening; it is not proof that the page permits iframe embedding or direct video playback.
Entries without webUrl remain in the catalogue until an official link is supplied.
